name: switchboard
description: Switchboard — an operator console for AI agent collaboration (Electron shell + embedded message server + Angular console).
author: Owen Morgan

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:app && npm run build:ui
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:server && npm run build:app && concurrently -k -s first -n ui,electron -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.package:win-x64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-server-runtime.js --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-server-runtime.js --platform darwin && electron-builder --mac
